nonBattleUses.role: Trophy icons; not proof of battle environment

sharedSpawn.finding: Only the150px portrait is shared across fog and arena. Standing and defeat are already separate spawn.png versus gladiator_spawn.png. The current code renders a different parent battle background for fog and arena, but an opaque per-MOB scene can conceal it.

futureMinimalOption.portrait: Keep spawn_ava.png for fog and trophy compatibility; add a separate arena portrait PNG and change only #противники arena enemy portrait binding at3196.
futureMinimalOption.standingAndDefeat: No new context variable or migration required: existing arena key исчадие_арены already uses gladiator_spawn.png and defeated/gladiator_spawn.png, while3fog keys share spawn.png and defeated/spawn.png.
futureMinimalOption.saveCompatibility: Persistent enemy keys and gameplay values stay unchanged. Native new-fight initialization reloads #противники. Already-open battle saves can retain old cached portrait/header until an explicit refresh/redraw; verify that case before claiming full compatibility.

imageFileMetadata.interpretation: Pixel opacity is verified only; opaque does not by itself prove the depicted background fits its gameplay location. No images were edited.
